_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Qanri P'ukllayuq {player_id} Tic Tac Toe-pi.
Qanran goalninqa kimsa kutinpi atinku (wakin, tiksi, icha q'ara) p'ankallapi.
Qanran p'unchaypi, qanqa wak'asqa k'uska (0-8) q'ipirninkichaw munan.
Sapaq, '[4]' qanran markan p'ankallap chawpin cellapi.
P'ukllayuq {player_id}-kama, qanqa '{symbol}'-si, wakichaw '{opponent_symbol}'-si.
